fusions.name: Taproot Spear
fusions.desc: A rooted spear driven ahead that deals 14 damage, up to 1.8 times that at maximum range, and stuns the target for 1 second. Each hit has a 50% chance to leave it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Sprouting Shale
fusions.desc: Gravel bursts up around you, dealing 3 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and healing you for 10% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Mossed Bulwark
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Deep Roots
fusions.desc: Your maximum health rises by 8%, and you regenerate 0.5 health a second, permanently.
